jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.
There is an open part time cafeteria worker position at the following location:

Lunenburg Middle High School
1079 Mass Ave, Lunenburg, MA  01462

GENERAL
The ideal candidate should be energetic, motivated individual to work collaboratively with co-workers and school administration.
Responsibilities include (but are not limited to): meal prep work, dishwashing, and general kitchen duties.
This is a school-year position--18.75 hours per week. 

REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
Cashier and POS computer system experience preferred, but not required.


The position will remain open until filled with a qualified applicant.

OTHER
Salary per Lunenburg Cafeteria Employees collective bargaining agreement.  
Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.
